verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships its own MDM for macOS and Windows. Admins can confirm devices are managed, see each device's security posture, enforce settings via a one-click secure baseline, and enroll Macs through Apple MDM or Automated Device Enrollment. The evidence never names the specific checks the story asks for or shows per-employee compliance tracking, so only the general posture capability is proven. Missing for 10: documented disk-encryption, screen-lock and password-manager checks; per-employee mapping of device compliance; independent or hands-on corroboration.
